description: This file declares functions and macros related to HTTP Negotiate authentication, specifically for SPNEGO support within the cURL project. It contains function prototypes for processing Negotiate headers and cleanup, conditioned on build flags.

methods.name: Curl_input_negotiate
methods.description: Processes incoming Negotiate headers for SPNEGO authentication in HTTP requests.

methods.name: Curl_output_negotiate
methods.description: Creates and outputs the Negotiate header for HTTP requests.

methods.name: Curl_http_auth_cleanup_negotiate
methods.description: Performs cleanup of resources related to HTTP Negotiate authentication.
